title: Money Basics
blurb: Start here: what money is for and the three habits that matter.
cards: Money is a tool for trading your time and skills for what you need. How you use it matters more than how much you have. The three basics: earn it, spend it wisely, and keep some for later.
Which describes the three basics of money?
Earning, spending wisely and saving are the foundation of every money skill you will learn here.
Saving a small amount regularly can matter more than saving a lot once.
Habits beat one-off efforts. Small, regular saving builds up and teaches you to pay yourself first.
You get 100 as a gift. Which choice is best for your future self?
Leave it in your pocket and forget it
Balancing enjoyment now with savings for later is the heart of smart money habits.
example: You receive $100. You might spend $30 on something you enjoy, put $50 toward a goal, and keep $20 for a future need. The right split depends on your priorities.
